_comment: Core 3.5 constants: the things every game of this edition shares, whatever
table it is played at. Nothing setting-specific belongs in this file.
A RULESET sits on top of this and decides which optional systems are in
play - see web/data/rulesets/. The SRD ruleset turns almost nothing on;
the Antaera one turns on gestalt, action points, taint and the rest.
Splitting them this way is what lets the same engine run a public 3.5
character creator and one particular campaign's houserules without either

pointBuyCosts._note: Cost to raise a score from the base of 8. The budget itself is the ruleset's choice.

hitPoints.maxAtFirstNote: A character's first hit die always yields its maximum. A ruleset may switch this off.

_note: Two bonuses of the same type do not stack: the larger applies. The three
exceptions stack with themselves, and are the reason this list exists as
data rather than as an if-statement somewhere.
An untyped bonus stacks with everything, including other untyped ones.

wealthByLevel._note: From the DMG's character wealth table, used by most tables to judge a new character of a given level. A ruleset decides whether it is advice or a limit.
wealthByLevel.firstLevelNote: 1st level uses the class starting-gold roll rather than the table.

dying.note: A dying character loses 1 hit point a round and dies at -10 unless stabilised.
